description: Search products in Shopify stores that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent, by keywords matched against title, vendor, product type, tags and keywords. Returns store domain, numeric product_id, title, vendor, product URL and the last synced availability with its sync time. It never returns a price or a live offer: call verify_agent_offer with the returned shop and product_id to read live price and availability and obtain a native checkout link.

in_stock_only.description: Only products available at the last catalog sync (still verify live)

shop.description: Restrict to one store domain, e.g. example.myshopify.com

name: search_catalog
title: Search Seller Agent catalogs
